zh.name: 更新了什么与该怎么做
zh.summary: 把产品或平台变化对应到实际界面、受影响人群和下一步操作。
zh.useWhen: 变化与行动必须一一对应；区别于单纯产品截图展示。
zh.instructions: 官方变更依据、版本日期、前后界面、受众影响
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Product Change News
en.summary: Create an Instagram news carousel using the product change news structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the product change news format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.
